items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Bob Smiley had to drive the car, and Sonny Moore, vocalist, and myself, we rode the car with Smiley.

ctx.x: To the car. Bob Smiley had to drive the car, and Sonny Moore, vocalist, and myself, we rode the car with Smiley. We rode with him. I wasn't too ashamed to ride with him -- a great, big, beautiful red Packard. And brother, when we ride into any of them towns, well, you thought we were somethin'. And we'd get there ahead of time. We could get to the hotel and get rooms -- there's no trouble gettin' rooms. We'd be the first one in town, get our rooms -- and when they comin' down, we'd be in bed sleeping.
